decision: blocked on qualified genre labels and separately implemented/reviewed live capability

providers.tagging: authentic frozen local MusicBrainz/Discogs fixtures only; no upstream forwarding
providers.fingerprint: disabled; synthetic silence is not identity evidence
providers.reasoningCandidate: explicitly disabled only if endpoint contract supports it; no hidden charge assumption
providers.requiredPrivacy: data_collection deny; zdr true; account ZDR only excluding Safety Retention; exact provider terms reviewed
providers.currentCompatibility: mock scope rejects external endpoints and routing metadata; none of these live restrictions is implemented by this proposal

isolationAndWrites.roots: Only freshly generated silent disposable media in a new admitted scratch root. Original library paths, user caches/config and historical evidence are never write targets. Exact future roots and generated hashes remain unresolved.
isolationAndWrites.caches: Separate fresh provider caches, aliases and worker stores per arm/job; warm uses only its own cold cache and fresh profile-equivalent media. Cold/warm describes local cache, not remote model-cache state.
isolationAndWrites.modelRequests: Disabled jobs and Billie/Paint controls authorize zero model requests. Only Crowd assistance phases may admit one each; zero or one total is valid if eligibility/stop denies further dispatch. Never force traffic to consume the ceiling.
isolationAndWrites.mutationScope: Genre-only role is not genre-only writes. Existing coordinator still applies a whole validated provider candidate through WriteQueue. Before later execution, freeze per-field expected provider/local transformations and exact allowed paths; diff every before/proposed/readback field. Catalog labels grant no write authority.
isolationAndWrites.protected: Preserve meaningful versions, multi-performer credits and presentation, positive captured numbering/totals, local genre choices/cleanup, selected identity, content-only ID suppression and inferred-unverified obligations. Missing totals may receive the unchanged deterministic fallback, not AI improvement credit. Do not impose catalog position as a numbering rewrite.
isolationAndWrites.ancillary: Disable artwork, lyrics, acoustic, background/deferred retries and all other live ancillary fetches. Sidecars, cache and worker writes must be confined to declared disposable paths. No new behavior or authority is implemented here.
isolationAndWrites.errorPrivacy: Ordinary genre errors can include remote text in logs/events. A later live boundary needs a bounded allowlisted error projection, not raw remote errors or auth headers in artifacts/renderer. No sanitization guarantee is established today.

costIllustration.pricingDate: 2026-11-11 public documentation observation, not a price lock
costIllustration.interpretation: Illustrative envelope only. Exact endpoint price/fees and token semantics must fit a new reviewed binding before dispatch. Neither 0.012288 nor 0.05 USD is authorization or an enforced ceiling.

accounting.reservation: Atomically reserve worst-case attempt, bytes, input and output allowances before every wire dispatch across cold/warm; retain on failure; no refund for unknown usage.
stop: missing approval or consumed run id
accounting.afterStop: No later dispatch or queued/staged write; retain every requested slot. Atomic write already admitted may finish. Local cancellation is not remote cancellation or billing cessation.
accounting.providerWide: 512 is a proposed new local-fixture admission cap, not an existing model-ledger guarantee. It covers both arms and phases. Inventory/model/denied traffic is counted separately; no live tagging providers.
accounting.unknownOutcome: An attempted request may be billed even without a response. Preserve full reservation and mark billing unknown. A later generation/usage lookup needs separately scoped consent; do not retry inference.

genrePayload: all candidate track titles including version qualifiers
privacy.secretBoundary: Native-only lookup after authenticated approval and bindings; Authorization header only to exact approved HTTPS endpoint. No JS/renderer key, credential migration or dotenv import.
privacy.otherDisclosure: OpenRouter and selected inference provider see the payload, client IP and request metadata. Account/provider retention terms and legal exceptions apply; ZDR is not independently verified here.
privacy.redactionImpact: Do not redact artist/album/title to opaque IDs: that removes the semantic evidence this role uses. Redacting meaningful qualifiers changes the task and invalidates bindings. A metadata disclosure objection blocks this sample.
privacy.metadataRoleLeak: TagCorrectionResponse currently includes full_path, folder/parent, filenames, hints and per-track credits/numbers/genre. It is excluded, not silently redacted or enabled.
privacy.logs: Raw prompts/responses/network receipts remain local under .amp/in, no auth headers/secrets. Review before sharing. Portable receipts contain hashes, selectors, bounded allowlisted telemetry and independently reviewed labels, not full raw logs.

approval.reuse: No resume/reset/replay after crash. A durable authenticated consumed claim survives restart. Separate processes share the same claim. New attempt requires new identity-bound approval and limits.
approval.requiredBinding: Authenticated user approval outside the untrusted manifest signs/binds exact manifest digest, identity, source/build/executable/tools, sample/labels/raw fixtures, profile inputs and actual prewrite reader snapshots, requests/settings, transport/privacy/pricing/cap receipts, limits, expiry and run id. Subsequent observed readbacks bind to execution receipts, never desired-output authorization.
approval.current: Caller-supplied mock digest and exclusive local claim are byte binding only; no authenticated live trust root exists. No credential is requested now.

publication.beforeDispatch: Freeze exact requested membership, source/compiler/build/executable/tool hashes, inputs and actual prewrite reader/full/payload hashes, raw fixtures/labels, final serialized request hashes including effective settings; reject differences before credential lookup. Historical prewrites do not authorize future bytes.
publication.outputs: Per-job prewrite/proposal/readback, candidate/provider/field provenance, scope ledger for every attempt, bounded allowlisted usage/diagnostics, queue/payload/readback integrity, persisted inferred-unverified review after reopen. UI highlighting/acknowledgment needs a separate packaged UI check.
publication.authoritativeStatus: Publish selection status last after native exit/service/integrity/projection gates. Per-job scores provisional. Missing, unreadable or incomplete status rejects all success claims.
publication.failureDenominators: Retain all 12 requested evaluations, 144 repeated file observations and 432 field slots, even when zero or only some jobs finish. Unavailable means unavailable, not fabricated baseline/readback. Abrupt host termination cannot guarantee a completed envelope.
publication.modelCredit: Zero until independent genre annotations are frozen and matched-input disabled-versus-assistance outcomes support a useful correct fill. Exposed cases cannot prove generalization. No accepted certificate or writable delta follows.
